description: Generate React TypeScript source files for a web app based on the given IR2 intermediate representation.

roles.display: string — label shown in login form

defaultRoutesPerRole.<role_value>: string — first route after login for this role

participants.name: string — PascalCase module folder name (e.g. GuestFoodConsumption)
participants.defaultRoute: string — first route for this participant

tasks.name: string — PascalCase task name (used as component name prefix)
tasks.route: string — URL path for this page
tasks.description: string — intent of the page for LLM

stateWrites.value: string | boolean | object — value or description of value

waitCondition.field: string — processState key that must be truthy

autoWriteOnMount.value: boolean | string — value written in useEffect on mount

tasks.nextRoute: string — navigate() target after main action

ui.title: string — page heading
ui.hint: string — UI layout or interaction hints for LLM

fields.name: files
fields.description: List of all source files to generate.

core.description: Root app + router setup. Register all routes from IR2 sharedContext.allRoutes, wrap each with ProtectedRoute using allowedRoles.

Zustand store. Auth state (isAuthenticated, user, login, logout) uses sessionStorage. ProcessState uses localStorage with cross-tab sync via window.dispatchEvent(StorageEvent). Export type Role from sharedContext.roles[].internal. Build ProcessState type from sharedContext.stateSchema keys.

Login page. Render role selector from IR2 sharedContext.roles (display + value) and a name input. On submit, call login() from globalState then navigate to sharedContext.defaultRoutesPerRole[selectedRole].
Sidebar layout using Outlet. Navigation links per role filtered from sharedContext.allRoutes by user.role. Includes logout button and process reset button (calls resetProcess()).
Route guard. Redirect unauthenticated users to /login. Redirect wrong-role users to sharedContext.defaultRoutesPerRole[user.role].
Reusable atomic components: Card (title prop + children), Button (type, onClick, disabled, fullWidth, className), Input (label, value, onChange, placeholder).

pageType_logic.write-navigate: Render action UI. On button click: call updateProcessState(stateWrites), then navigate(nextRoute). No conditions.
pageType_logic.wait-then-write: Read waitCondition.field from processState. If falsy: show waiting UI with readableLabel. If truthy: activate main action button. On click: call updateProcessState(stateWrites), then navigate(nextRoute).
pageType_logic.form-write-navigate: Render form with inputs. Pre-fill from stateReads if specified. On submit: collect form values, call updateProcessState(stateWrites) with form data, then navigate(nextRoute).
pageType_logic.read-display-navigate: Read stateReads fields from processState for display only. No updateProcessState calls. On button click: navigate(nextRoute).
pageType_logic.auto-write-on-mount: On mount (useEffect): call updateProcessState({ [autoWriteOnMount.field]: autoWriteOnMount.value }) if not already set. Then behave as wait-then-write for the waitCondition.
